title: Preview Validation workflow 401 from fork context
body: The 'Get PR number' step in .github/workflows/preview-validation.yml fails with 'Bad credentials' (401) when the workflow is triggered by a deployment_status event in a fork PR context. The workflow uses actions/github-script@v8 with context.payload.deployment.id from a base-repo deployment, but the fork's GITHUB_TOKEN cannot authenticate cross-repo. Fix: re-trigger deployment or ensure workflow runs from base repo context, not a fork.
rationale: This is a known GitHub Actions limitation — fork GITHUB_TOKENs cannot access base repo resources. The workflow needs to run in the base repo with a token that has access to the deployment.
